mapper.select: SELECT TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ AS ticketProductSeq, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, TICKET_COUNT AS ticketCount, PRICE AS price, ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM TICKET_PRODUCT WHERE ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY PRICE

SELECT TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ AS ticketProductSeq, PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, TICKET_COUNT AS ticketCount, PRICE AS price, ACTIVE_YN AS activeYn, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM TICKET_PRODUCT WHERE TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ = #{ticketProductSeq} AND ACTIVE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO MEMBER_WALLET W USING (SELECT #{memberSeq} AS MEMBER_SEQ FROM DUAL) S ON (W.MEMBER_SEQ = S.MEMBER_SEQ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MEMBER_WALLET_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, TICKET_BALANCE, MILEAGE_BALANCE, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_MEMBER_WALLET.NEXTVAL, S.MEMBER_SEQ, 0, 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_WALLET_SEQ AS memberWalletSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, TICKET_BALANCE AS ticketBalance, MILEAGE_BALANCE AS mileageBalance, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM MEMBER_WALLET WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}

SELECT MEMBER_WALLET_SEQ AS memberWalletSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, TICKET_BALANCE AS ticketBalance, MILEAGE_BALANCE AS mileageBalance, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM MEMBER_WALLET WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_PAYMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAYMENT_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ, PG_TRANSACTION_ID, PAYMENT_METHOD, PRODUCT_PRICE, MILEAGE_USED, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, TICKET_COUNT, PAYMENT_STATUS, PAID_AT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{paymentSeq}, #{memberSeq}, #{ticketProductSeq}, #{pgTransactionId}, NULL, #{productPrice}, #{mileageUsed}, #{paymentAmount}, #{ticketCount}, 'READY', NULL, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PAYMENT_SEQ AS paymentSeq, MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ AS ticketProductSeq, PG_TRANSACTION_ID AS pgTransactionId, PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, MILEAGE_USED AS mileageUsed, PAYMENT_AMOUNT AS paymentAmount, TICKET_COUNT AS ticketCount, PAYMENT_STATUS AS paymentStatus, PAID_AT AS paidAt, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PAYMENT WHERE PG_TRANSACTION_ID = #{pgTransactionId} AND MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT SET PAYMENT_STATUS = 'PAID', PAYMENT_METHOD = #{paymentMethod}, PAID_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PG_TRANSACTION_ID = #{pgTransactionId} AND PAYMENT_STATUS = 'READY'
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM ( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM MILEAGE_LEDGER WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY MILEAGE_LEDGER_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) FROM DUAL
SELECT NVL(( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM ( SELECT BALANCE_AFTER FROM TICKET_LEDGER WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} ORDER BY TICKET_LEDGER_SEQ DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_WALLET SET TICKET_BALANCE = #{ticketBalance}, MILEAGE_BALANCE = #{mileageBalance}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TICKET_LEDGER ( TICKET_LEDGER_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PAYMENT_SEQ, SOURCE_TYPE, CHANGE_AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_TICKET_LEDGER.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{paymentSeq}, #{sourceType}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, SYSDATE )

INSERT INTO MILEAGE_LEDGER ( MILEAGE_LEDGER_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ, PAYMENT_SEQ, SOURCE_TYPE, CHANGE_AMOUNT, BALANCE_AFTER, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MILEAGE_LEDGER.NEXTVAL, #{memberSeq}, #{paymentSeq}, #{sourceType}, #{changeAmount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{description}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT p.PAYMENT_SEQ AS paymentSeq, p.MEMBER_SEQ AS memberSeq, p.TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ AS ticketProductSeq, NVL(tp.PRODUCT_NAME, '채팅 이용권 ' || p.TICKET_COUNT || '개') AS productName, p.PG_TRANSACTION_ID AS pgTransactionId, p.PAYMENT_METHOD AS paymentMethod, p.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, p.MILEAGE_USED AS mileageUsed, p.PAYMENT_AMOUNT AS paymentAmount, p.TICKET_COUNT AS ticketCount, p.PAYMENT_STATUS AS paymentStatus, p.PAID_AT AS paidAt, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PAYMENT p LEFT JOIN TICKET_PRODUCT tp ON p.TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ = tp.TICKET_PRODUCT_SEQ WHERE p.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND p.PAYMENT_STATUS != 'READY' ORDER BY p.PAYMENT_SEQ DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE PAYMENT SET PAYMENT_STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE PAYMENT_SEQ = #{paymentSeq} AND PAYMENT_STATUS = 'PAID'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_CANCEL ( PAYMENT_CANCEL_SEQ, PAYMENT_SEQ, PG_CANCEL_ID, CANCEL_AMOUNT, CANCEL_REASON, CANCELLED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PAYMENT_CANCEL.NEXTVAL, #{paymentSeq}, #{pgCancelId}, #{cancelAmount}, #{cancelReason}, SYSDATE )
